authority.extractionLimitation: This instrument's text is drawn with a font whose encoding offsets every character by -29. Letters decode cleanly and are transcribed below. The digits do not survive extraction at all, so the form NUMBERS this guide cites for its Notice and its second Order could not be read first-hand and are recorded as unknown rather than guessed. JDF-416, the sibling guide for the non-conviction route, does extract cleanly and names its four filings explicitly; the two guides share an identical four-filing structure.
authority.notRatified: This is the issuing court's own participant guide, transcribed. It is not a legal opinion by this lane and it has not been through Colorado counsel review, which the state index still records as missing from the supplied corpus.

preparation: Verify your conviction can be sealed.
Wait for the time minimum from completing your sentence.
Get the mailing address for every agency with your records.
Get a criminal history report from www.cbirecordscheck.com (possible fees), then start the filing step within the stated number of days of that report.
Check with your local court to see if it also requires an FBI fingerprint-based report.

copyAndService.requirement: Mail a copy of your motion to the Prosecuting Attorney's office.
copyAndService.note: This differs from the non-conviction route, which serves every records-holding agency instead.

hearingAndObjectionStops: The Court may hold a hearing.
Be prepared to show why you qualify to have your case sealed.
If your request to seal records is denied you must wait one year before making another request.
postFilingSteps: If the court approves the request, the Court sends the order to the agency addresses listed in the petition.
The agencies generally seal the records within the stated number of days of receiving the order.
eligibilityStopsOnFace: Not all convictions can be sealed; the Motion itself carries the list of convictions that cannot be sealed.
Your case cannot be sealed if you still owe restitution.
Time starts at the end of all criminal proceedings or release from supervision, whichever happens later.

waitTimeTiersOnFace.extractionLimitation: The tier headings decode but their year counts are digits and do not survive extraction. The tiers are transcribed in order without their numbers rather than guessed.
